s1.syndrome_frame: Pelvic mass with chronic pelvic pain
salient_findings: Hypoechoic mass measuring approximately 6.2 cm in diameter with an irregular border over the right adnexa
Round and smooth surface mass arising from the isthmus of the right tube
key_facts: 36-year-old woman
Gravida 2, para 2
Previously diagnosed with presumed progressive uterine fibroids 6 months earlier
Presenting with right lower pelvic pain
Transabdominal sonography showed a hypoechoic mass
Computed tomography showed a moderately enhanced right adnexal tumor
Laparoscopic findings revealed a round and smooth surface mass
Pathological examination revealed a benign lesion
Frozen section revealed a benign lesion
Final pathology showed spindle cells and cords of epithelioid cells
Immunohistochemistry was positive for vimentin, desmin, smooth muscle actin, and estrogen and progesterone receptors
